global_prompt: A photorealistic cinematic golf scene set on a beautiful golf course during golden hour, captured in one continuous shot without cuts. The camera uses smooth tilts, low-angle tracking movements, and natural reframing to follow the action.
local_prompts: A close-up shows a male golfer's face as he looks downward with a focused expression on a sunlit golf course.
The camera tilts downward from the golfer's face to reveal his shoes, golf club, and a white golf ball resting on the grass.
The golfer lightly taps the white golf ball with his club, causing it to begin rolling across the green.
The camera tracks the golf ball as it rolls across the putting green, approaching the hole and gradually slowing down.
The golf ball stops just a few centimeters short of the hole without falling in.
A small brown squirrel enters the frame and approaches the stationary golf ball beside the hole.
The squirrel pushes the golf ball with its front paws, causing the ball to roll into the hole.
